killedBy: vendored third-party source (issue #771) accounts for every font file under src/game/fonts, so a new face cannot ship without its notice
vendored third-party source (issue #771) names every vendored file in CONTENT-LICENSE.md, which would otherwise class it as first-party code
why: A font file that ships without a declaration: the 600 weight of IBM Plex Mono stays in src/game/fonts and is emitted into dist/, but the notices stop naming it. Nothing reads the font directory except the inventory, so only it names the file; the CONTENT-LICENSE.md test fails through its control, which expects all six font files when the fonts' row is removed. Scoped to vendored.test.ts alone: generate.test.ts's regenerate-and-diff would also fail, but only until `npm run notices` is run, after which the declaration and the committed notices agree on the mistake.
